update.title: Title of the dialog that reviews a plugin's update. {{name}} is the plugin's name, {{version}} the new version.
update.adds: The dialog's text when the new version may do more.
update.adds-nothing: The dialog's text when it may do nothing more.
update.additions: Heading over the list of what the new version adds.
update.removed: Heading over the settings the new version drops.
update.cancel: Button that closes the dialog without updating.
additions.egress: One addition: the plugin's service may reach a new host ({{host}}, a domain name).
additions.egress-setting: One addition: it may reach the host a setting names. {{field}} is the setting's technical name, {{host}} the host it names now.
additions.egress-setting-any: One addition: it may reach whatever host an admin enters in a setting. {{field}} is the setting's technical name.
additions.permission: One addition: a new permission. {{permission}} is its technical name, like calendar:read.
additions.bridge-open: One addition: the plugin may ask the workspace to open a link. {{url}} is the link.
additions.bridge-open-any-https: One addition: it may ask to open any https link, each one confirmed by the person. https is a protocol; keep it.
additions.embed: One addition: it now shows inside the workspace, in a frame.
additions.action: One addition: socios (the product's AI agents) may ask to use one of its actions. {{action}} is the action's technical name, {{tier}} its access level's technical name.
additions.action-changed: One addition: an action's access level changes. {{action}}, {{from}} and {{tier}} are technical names.
additions.always-ask-dropped: One addition: a socio's access request no longer always shows the person's approval card.
additions.bridge-routes: One addition: the plugin's own pages get addresses in the workspace (deep links).
additions.secret: One addition: it asks for a new secret, required or optional. {{name}} is the secret's technical name.
additions.service-secret: One addition: a secret given to its service at runtime. {{name}} is the secret's technical name.
additions.dataset: One addition: a new dataset need, to read or to read and write. {{name}} is the need's technical name.
additions.dataset-write: One addition: a dataset need it only read is now written too. {{name}} is the need's technical name.
additions.webhook: One addition: it accepts requests from anyone on the internet. {{method}} is an HTTP method (GET, POST), {{path}} an address path.
additions.webhook-limit: One addition: such a path accepts larger or more requests. {{method}} and {{path}} as above.
additions.public-path: One addition: a path it serves without the signed note (envelope) saying which socio asks. {{path}} is the path.
additions.cpus: One addition: its service asks for more processors. {{from}} and {{to}} are numbers.
additions.memory: One addition: its service asks for more memory, in megabytes. {{from}} and {{to}} are numbers.
additions.volume: One addition: a storage volume it keeps data on. {{name}} is the volume's technical name.
uninstall.title: Title of the dialog that uninstalls a plugin. {{name}} is its name.
uninstall.description-bundled: The dialog's text for a plugin that runs inside Socio.
uninstall.description-service: The dialog's text for a plugin that runs as its own service. Its identity is its service account.
uninstall.type: Label of the field where the admin types the plugin's name to confirm. <name> wraps {{name}}, the name, in bold; keep the tag around it.
uninstall.name: Accessible name of that field.
uninstall.mismatch: Shown while what is typed doesn't match the name.
uninstall.keep: Button that closes the dialog without uninstalling.
uninstall.uninstall: Destructive button that uninstalls the plugin.
